title: Monthly bookkeeping is still manual
text: Every month I still do this manually: I export the bank transactions from Xero to CSV, then copy and paste them into Excel because the client's CRM doesn't integrate with our accounting software. It takes me hours every week and re-keying the reference numbers is where mistakes creep in.
author: ledger_lucy

title: Onboarding clients into Sage
text: We run an accountancy practice and use Sage for the year-end accounts, but new client data arrives in HubSpot. I have to manually export a CSV and re-key each client into Sage, which takes about three hours every week and it is mind numbing.
author: practice_pete

title: Reconciling QuickBooks with Stripe
text: As a bookkeeper, I find QuickBooks and Stripe do not reconcile automatically for us, so at month end I download both reports and work through the differences by hand in Google Sheets. It takes me a whole afternoon.
author: recon_rita

title: Council portal has no API
text: The council portal has no API so our finance assistant manually downloads the payment file each week and types the totals into Unit4. We pay someone to do this data entry and it is copy and paste all afternoon.
author: finance_frank

title: Manual invoice sync to Xero is painful
text: Our finance team at the accounting firm has to manually copy invoice data from our internal admin tool into Xero. They complain it takes two days every month and the VAT totals are always out by a few pounds.

title: Budgeting app gaps
text: I wish my personal budgeting app integrated with my bank. I have to copy transactions manually into Google Sheets every week for my own budget and it is annoying.

title: MTD quarterly re-keying
text: Since HMRC made Making Tax Digital mandatory for sole traders, I have had to re-key the quarterly figures from my spreadsheet into the tax software every quarter. It is a nightmare and takes a full day each time.
author: tax_tina

title: 3PL CSV upload
text: Our 3PL requires a CSV upload of every order because there is no integration with our Shopify store. We export the orders and re-key the addresses by hand every morning.
author: shop_sam

title: Amazon orders re-keyed daily
text: We manually re-key Amazon orders into our inventory system every day. Someone on the team spends two hours on it before the warehouse opens.
author: warehouse_wendy

title: Clinic appointment reminders
text: As a clinic manager, I still run appointment reminders in Excel and then manually type them into the practice management system. I wish it integrated with our booking tool; it wastes a whole afternoon every week.
author: clinic_claire

title: Matter tracking then billing
text: As a solicitor, I track matters in a spreadsheet and then manually enter them into the billing system. It is a couple of hours every week and the fee earners hate it.
author: legal_laura

title: WooCommerce to fulfilment
text: Our online store runs on WooCommerce and every order has to be typed into the fulfilment system by hand because the integration only sends tracking numbers one way.
author: store_stu

title: Manual stock tracker
text: We sell on Amazon and Shopify and then manually copy the order list into a Google Sheets stock tracker every day. It is error prone and nobody enjoys it.
author: multi_mia

title: Salesforce outage workaround
text: Salesforce went down this morning so we had to type tickets into a spreadsheet for an hour. Back to normal now.
